description: Correct a store's profile when the USER tells you it's wrong (e.g. 'we're actually a premium brand', 'people DO buy our products as gifts at Christmas', 'we're skincare not cosmetics'). Corrections are authoritative: they override the system's guess immediately AND survive the monthly auto-regeneration. ONLY call this from something the user stated about their own store — never from your own inference. `giftLed` especially matters: it controls whether retail gift-holidays are treated as relevant for this store. Confirm to the user once saved.

brandTerms.description: Canonical brand terms (e.g. ['wills vegan','willsveganstore']) used to classify branded vs non-branded queries in get_connector_data(connector:'google-search-console', report:'branded_split'). Pin these when the auto-detected branded% looks wrong or differs between calls — pinned terms make the split deterministic across every caller. Accepts an array or a comma-separated string.

giftLed.description: True if products are typically bought as gifts for others; false for considered/self-purchase goods. Controls retail-calendar gift-event relevance.

note.description: Free-text authoritative context to remember and feed into future profile regenerations.

positioning.description: How the store competes (e.g. ethical, budget, specialist).

store.description: Which store to correct (short or full domain). Required.

name: update_store_profile
